name: Income certificate (revenue department)
description: The certificate of annual family income issued by the revenue department / Mandal (Taluka) Revenue Officer. Needed for scholarships, fee waivers and other schemes that carry income ceilings.
illustrative_rules: Applying for an income certificate requires a self-declaration of annual family income, proof of identity (Aadhaar) and a recent declaration. Certificate validity is state-specific — treat validity as an illustrative rule.
notes: Income-certificate issuance, renewal and validity are governed by state rules. The demo treats the 90-day declaration window as illustrative only.

process.name: Income certificate preparation review
process.description: Before the income certificate request is submitted, we check the self-declaration is recent and the identity documents are consistent.

name_check.description: The name on the self-declaration must match the Aadhaar.

requirements.name: Fresh declaration
requirements.message: The self-declaration is older than 90 days. Many authorities expect a fresh declaration for a new certificate.
requirements.suggestion: Complete the self-declaration form again so the date is recent.

required_document_messages.aadhaar: Aadhaar card — to prove identity and address.
required_document_messages.income_self_declaration: Income self-declaration — the basis for the certificate.

states.label: Upload documents
states.description: Upload Aadhaar and the income self-declaration.

states.label: Check documents
states.description: Comparing the declaration date and the names across documents.

states.label: Attention needed
states.description: One or more documents need your attention before submission. Fix the document, or acknowledge and continue as the human in charge.

states.label: Final review
states.description: Final human approval. Nothing is submitted without your explicit consent.

states.label: Submit application
states.description: Submitting the assembled application (simulated in the demo).

states.label: Submission blocked
states.description: A hard requirement failed. The application was NOT submitted.

states.label: Cancelled
states.description: The applicant chose not to submit.

states.label: Application ready
states.description: The reviewed application is ready to submit.
